name: Liferun
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a 133.33% week-over-week spike in Google Business Profile actions, likely driven by increased local search visibility or a seasonal uptick in direction and call intent. On the lead side, Meta is carrying all 138 tracked leads at a $15.76 CPL while Google Ads generated zero conversions despite $502.97 in spend, which warrants a conversion tracking audit.

performance.verdict: Meta CPL holding; Google $503 spend with zero conversions is the real blocker.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $502.97 over 28 days with 0 conversions recorded — conversion pixel is almost certainly broken, not the campaigns.
5 overdue SOW milestones (oldest: Jul 20) including paid landing pages, UGC batch, and end-to-end stack re-test — all unverified as of today.
GHL shows 134 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments, $0 pipeline value — leads arriving but no intake conversion, a CRM process leak not an ads problem.
Meta CPL is $15.76 over 28 days; 3-day signal (Sep 10–12: 6+4+0 leads, $91+$80+$11 spend) vs prior 3 (Sep 7–9: 6+10+12 leads) shows a softening lead rate into weekend — watch, not yet a trend.
IG reach is 0 across all 45 days in the series — IG connected per SOW but delivering nothing; dark channel leaking no spend but wasting setup.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking — $502.97 spent with 0 conversions confirms pixel failure, not campaign failure.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $502.97 over 28 days and recorded exactly 0 conversions — the pixel or goal configuration is broken client-side. Check the Google tag fires on the thank-you/confirmation page, confirm the conversion action is set to 'All conversions' not 'Optimised,' and verify no URL mismatch. Success = at least one test conversion recorded in Google Ads within 48 hours. Re-check by 2026-09-15.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 134 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — pipeline is filling but no one is progressing leads.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 134 opportunities created in 28 days but 0 won and 0 appointments booked, meaning leads are entering the pipeline and stalling immediately. Audit the first-stage automation: confirm follow-up sequences are active, CS (Cebu) permissions are correctly set per the SOW phone-order build, and the BWS duplicate-check is not creating dead contacts. Success = at least 5 appointments booked within the next 7 days. Re-check by 2026-09-20.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta lead rate through Sep 16 — 3-day softening (10 leads Sep 10–12 vs 28 prior 3 days) is not yet a confirmed trend.
suggestions.monday_update: The last 3 days (Sep 10–12) produced 10 leads vs 28 in the prior 3 days (Sep 7–9), but weekend drop-off is a known pattern in this series. No budget or creative action is warranted yet. Monitor daily lead count; if the weekday average (Mon–Wed Sep 15–17) falls below 6 leads/day, escalate to creative refresh. Re-check 2026-09-16.
